customManagers.description: Bump Go module tool versions pinned as workflow input defaults, marked with a 'renovate:' comment on the line above. Go module versions are always v-prefixed, in the datasource's own tags and in this file's defaults alike, so the matched value is reused as-is - nothing to add or strip.

Bump non-Go tool versions pinned as workflow input defaults, marked with a 'renovate:' comment on the line above. Split from the Go case above because the two disagree on the 'v' prefix: these defaults are written bare (e.g. a download URL built from the version has none), while their upstream release tags carry one - a single shared extractVersionTemplate stripping it for both classes is what silently dropped the 'v' from a Go module version too. The datasource group excludes exactly 'go' (leaving 'golang-version' and friends matchable) without a lookahead: Renovate compiles matchStrings with RE2, which rejects lookahead/lookbehind outright, so the exclusion is spelled out as alternation on the first couple of characters instead.

packageRules.description: Action and pinned tool bumps land as 'build' so they appear under the Dependencies changelog section; release-please treats 'build' as releasable (hidden: false in release-please-config.json) and cuts a patch release, updating the v0 tag that downstream repos consume.
Internal self-references use the moving v0 major tag on purpose - don't pin or bump them.
